P.name: Martial Cadence
P.title: Template:Data Jarvan IV/Martial Cadence
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Martial Cadence|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Jarvan IV
|skill        = I
|icon         = Martial Cadence.png
|blurbicon    = Martial Cadence.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Jarvan IV}} basic attacks deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} equal to a portion of the {{as|target's '''current''' health}}.
|blurb2       = This effect cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Jarvan IV's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} equal to {{as|8% of the target's '''current''' health}}, with a minimum threshold of 20 and capped at 400 against non-{{tip|champion}} targets.
|description2 = This effect cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds.
|ontargetcdstatic= {{pp|6 to 3 for 4|1 to 16}}
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spelleffects = Proc
|spellshield  = False
|parry        = True
|notes        = 
* ''Martial Cadence's'' damage is based on the current health of the target before any damage of the attack has been dealt.
* ''Martial Cadence's'' damage is dealt after the main attack damage.
** If the target dies to the main attack damage, the additional damage will not be dealt.
* The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|structures}}.
}}

E.name: Demacian Standard
E.title: Template:Data Jarvan IV/Demacian Standard
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Demacian Standard|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Jarvan IV
|skill        = E
|icon         = false
|icon2        = Demacian Standard.png
|blurbicon    = Demacian Standard.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Jarvan IV}} gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.
|blurb2       = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jarvan IV''' plants a flag at the target location that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
|blurb3       = The flag lingers for a period, emitting an {{tip|aura}} that grants {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} to '''Jarvan''' and allied champions.
|description  = {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Jarvan IV''' gains {{sti|attack speed|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.
|leveling     = {{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|20 to 30}}%}}
|description2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jarvan IV''' throws a Demacian flag to the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within the area.
|leveling2    = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 240}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}}}
|description3 = The flag then remains for 8 seconds, granting {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings and providing an {{tip|aura}} that grants ''Demacian Standard's'' passive {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} to all nearby allied champions as well as '''Jarvan IV''' {{tt|himself|See notes}}.
|cooldown     = {{ap|12 to 10}}
|cast time = none
|cost         = 55
|costtype     = Mana
|target range = 860
|effect radius= {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|200|Impact radius}}|{{tt|1000|Aura radius}}|{{tip|sight|icononly = true}}{{tt|700|Sight range}}}}
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spelleffects = Aoe
|spellshield  = True
|grounded     = 
|outofrange   = cast at max
|notes        = 
* The attack speed granted from a deployed ''Demacian Standard'' {{tip|stacks additively}} with ''Demacian Standard's'' passive permanent bonus attack speed to '''Jarvan IV''', but the aura from multiple ''Demacian Standards'' does not stack.
** '''Jarvan IV''' gains a total of {{ap|20*2 to 30*2}}% bonus attack speed from ''Demacian Standard'' while near the flag.
* The flag has a {{fd|13.6}} {{tip|pathing radius}} and a 65 {{tip|gameplay radius}}.
** The gameplay radius matters to {{ai|Dragon Strike|Jarvan IV}}.
* ''Demacian Standard'' can be targeted by allied abilities ({{si|Teleport}}, {{ai|Safeguard|Lee Sin}}). The target type is the same as a {{tip|minion}}.
* ''Demacian Standard'' is {{tip|untargetable}} to enemies. 
}}

R.name: Cataclysm
R.title: Template:Data Jarvan IV/Cataclysm
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Cataclysm|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Jarvan IV
|skill        = R
|icon         = Cataclysm.png
|blurbicon    = Cataclysm.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Jarvan IV}} {{tip|dash|leaps}} {{tip|displacement immune|Unstoppably}} to the target enemy champion's location, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies upon impact.
|blurb2       = He then erects a circle of [[terrain]] that lasts for a short time.
|blurb3       = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Jarvan IV''' destroys the created terrain.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jarvan IV''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} to the target enemy champion's location over {{fd|0.35}} seconds, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to all nearby enemies upon arrival.
|leveling     = {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|200 to 450}} {{as|(+ 180% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
|description2 = Upon impact, he creates a circle of impassable terrain that {{tip|airborne|knocks aside}} enemies within the perimeter over {{fd|0.15}} seconds, knocking them out of the circle if they are on the outer edge and pulling them in otherwise. The terrain lasts for {{fd|3.5}} seconds and grants {{tip|sight}} of the area. ''Cataclysm'' can be recast after {{fd|0.75}} seconds while the terrain is present.
|description3 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Jarvan IV''' destroys the terrain created by ''Cataclysm''.
|cooldown     = {{ap|120 to 90}}
|cdstart      = post-effect
|cost         = 100
|cast time = none
|costtype     = Mana
|target range = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 650
|speed        = {{tt|Distance to target{{Divided by}}{{fd|0.35}} s|Dash speed varies based on cast distance}}
|effect radius= {{dv|{{tt|350|Terrain creation radius}}|{{tip|sight|icononly = true}}{{tt|1700|Sight range (from center of the whole structure)}}}}
|customlabel  = Impassable perimeter
|custominfo   = {{dv|{{tip|pathing radius|icononly = true}} {{tt|255|Inner radius}}|{{tt|445|Outer radius}}}}
|targeting    = Unit
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|grounded     = True
|knockdown    = False
|spelleffects = Aoe
|spellshield  = Special
|callforhelp  = True
|notes        = 
* The initial cast and the manual recast count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
** If the ability is not manually recasted, the secondary effect will trigger without being considered as an ability activation.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the damage but not the terrain generation.
* If '''Jarvan IV's''' {{tip|dash|leap}} is interrupted by another by another forced movement (eg. old {{cai|Impale old2|Skarner|variant=old|Impale}}<ref>[https://www.reddit.com/r/leagueoflegends/comments/njwmqn/skarners_ultimate_ignores_unstoppability/ Jarvan IV R vs old Skarner R]</ref>), the terrain will be generated at '''Jarvan IV's''' location when the forced movement ends.<!--there could be other examples like bugged infernal rift blast cone-->
* ''Cataclysm'' will not deal damage, generate terrain, nor refund its cooldown if '''Jarvan IV''' is killed while leaping.
* The perimeter is made up of 24 units with 95 {{tip|pathing radius}}, 65 {{tip|gameplay radius}} and 1350 {{tip|sight}} radius each. Only every other unit is rendered visible.
* {{cai|Searing Charge|Ornn}} will not destroy the whole ring but only the part that {{ci|Ornn}} collides with.
}}
